Rina Shah: Heads-up: we're prepping a customer case for Velocity.ai. Interview happened earlier today. Need one short customer quote for the blog + legal signoff on any numeric claims. Also planning a companion webinar to walk through the benchmark.

Tom Alvarez: I can take the metric verification. Transcript & benchmarks are here: https://drive.redwood.com/velocity/benchmarks. Will flag anything we can't substantiate.

Nina Gomez: Drafting the blog now. Can we get a 1-line quote and a 30-45s video clip from the customer? They said something strong about latency improvements.

Rina Shah: Raw quote from transcript: "Switching to Redwood cut our p99 latency in half and made interactive features feel snappy for our users."

Tom Alvarez: Quick check: product confirms p99 improvement was ~48% in the internal run on 2025-11-03. We can use "about half" or exact 48% if Legal wants the test ID attached. Test ID: run-vel-1125.

Nina Gomez: Proposed quote variants for legal:
1) "Velocity.ai cut p99 latency by about half, making interactive features feel snappier."
2) "In our internal benchmark (run-vel-1125), p99 latency improved 48% after migrating to Redwood."

Legal Review Bot: LR-510 opened. Please attach the benchmark CSV and the customer's consent to publish.

Tom Alvarez: Attached benchmark CSV and test notes to the ticket. Noting the test used synthetic traffic at 95th percentile concurrency.

Nina Gomez: I'll slot the cleaner one-line quote in the draft and keep the detailed stat in a footnote. Also planning a short webinar (30 min) to present the benchmark + Q&A.

Events Bot: Tentative webinar page created: Thu Jun 12, 09:00 PT. RSVP link: https://events.redwood.com/velocity-webinar. Confirm speakers and recording permissions.

Rina Shah: Nina, please ask Velocity for headshot + 1-line bio and explicit permission to use the quote + clip. Tom, thank you for the test ID. Legal will need the CSV.

Tom Alvarez: On it. I'll request the customer's signoff on the exact quote language and confirm recording permissions. Updating thread when I have signoff. :white_check_mark:
